author: Guerrilla Miniature Games
description:
We're back with The Indie Hour Episode Eighty-Seven! This series focuses on games you may have never even heard of and gives us an inside look at the wider world of independantly published Tabletop Wargames of all genres.

You wake up encrusted in ice, your last memories in a haunted hive world that of death and destruction. Your blood has been replaced with something awful and everything hurts. Worse yet; you're being hunted by survivors for that same magical substance. Welcome to PETRICHOR, the survival horror game where you're the undead and the humans are the monsters! MSPaints and Rogues Den Hobbies have teamed up for this direct to retail launch. Let's check it out!

Check out the the physical game and models for  HERE: https://roguesdenhobbies.com/products/petrichor-blood-runs-cold-rulebook
title: The GMG Indie Hour Ep 087 - PETRICHOR  by Rogues Den Hobbies and MSPaints
